en: Sepia panoramic view of the mountain resort of Sinaia with grand buildings and gardens beneath rocky peaks. The scene shows the Sinaia Casino and the large Palace Hotel in Dimitrie Ghica Park. The reverse bears Romanian text and address lines, printed heading 'Republica Populară Română', bilingual caption 'SINAIA: Vedere / СИНАЯ — Общий вид', and Romanian stamps with a 1951–1955 Five‑Year Plan motif. Postmarked in 1952 and addressed to Bucharest.
